segments.text:
V. 8.
If I waſh thee not—If thou doſt not ſubmit to my Will, thou haſt no part with me—Thou art not my Diſciple. In a more general Senſe it may mean, If I do not waſh thee in my Blood, and purify thee by my Spirit, thou canſt have no Communion with me, nor any Share in the Bleſſings of my Kingdom.
